claims.title: VPB has the highest Q4 2024 NPL ratio
claims.claim: In 2024_Q4, VPB bank.npl_g35 was 4.1956%, higher than ACB 1.5122%, TCB 1.17%, MBB 1.6205%, and VCB 0.9636%.
claims.interpretation: VPB had the highest reported share of loans in NPL groups 3-5 among the declared issuers in 2024_Q4.
claims.limitation: This is descriptive and does not establish causes or forward-looking risk.

claims.title: VPB profitability improved across 2024
claims.claim: VPB bank.roa increased from 1.2179% in 2024_Q1 to 1.8361% in 2024_Q4, while bank.roe increased from 8.0671% to 11.4117%.
claims.interpretation: The reported endpoint profitability measures were higher in Q4 than in Q1 for VPB.
claims.limitation: Endpoint comparison does not imply a continuous path or causality; ROA and ROE conventions should be considered.

claims.title: VCB led loss-loan coverage
claims.claim: VCB bank.llr_coverage was above the declared peer median in each quarter: 199.8177% versus 92.97875% in Q1, 212.1089% versus 101.0% in Q2, 204.6495% versus 79.0721% in Q3, and 223.311% versus 92.2484% in Q4.
claims.interpretation: VCB reported the strongest loss-loan coverage relative to the accepted five-issuer peer medians throughout 2024.
claims.limitation: The coverage definitions include source-specific conventions; this is not causal evidence of future credit performance.

claims.title: MBB NPL ratio moved non-monotonically

claims.interpretation: MBB exhibited a Q3 increase followed by a Q4 decrease in the reported NPL ratio.
claims.limitation: The pattern is descriptive; no cause is inferred.
